verdict.rationale: Docusign CLM and AI-Assisted Review provide playbook-based redlining, AI-suggested edits, and MS Word integration for negotiation, replacing ad hoc email redlines with a structured review workflow (docusign-docs-16, docusign-docs-20, docusign-docs-25, docusign-docs-28, docusign-docs-41, docusign-docs-44). However this is vendor-documented only, with no independent/hands-on evidence of real negotiation workflows in practice, and community commentary focuses on e-signature API reliability rather than contract drafting/redlining experience. missing for 10: independent or hands-on validation of the negotiation/redlining workflow, detail on multi-party collaborative drafting vs. simple template use, and evidence these CLM/AI-review features are broadly adopted rather than being newer add-on modules.
